title: A Matched-Budget Audit Framework for Recaptioned Image-Text Supervision Distributions
abstract: arXiv:2610.00952v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recaptioned image-text corpora are now standard for text-to-image (T2I) training, with vision--language model (VLM) captioners replacing sparse alt-text by dense descriptions. A recaptioned corpus is a supervision distribution induced by a documented captioning policy ($\pi$), captioner ($V_c$), and source corpus ($C$). Length-correlated proxies miss caption-register artifacts and downstream T2I benchmarks entangle the corpus with training choices, so this distribution is hard to audit at corpus scale. We introduce a reusable matched-budget audit framework for recaptioned supervision distributions $D_{\pi,V_c,C}$: at a fixed text budget of $B = 64$ it reports a five-axis profile spanning prompt-side coverage, image-conditioned faithfulness, and caption-surface health, with claimed controllable basic units (CBU) as the common claim unit. translated_title: 面向重标注图文监督分布的等预算审计框架
translated_abstract: 重标注的图文语料库如今已成为文本到图像（T2I）训练的标准数据来源，视觉-语言模型（VLM）描述器用密集的描述取代了稀疏的替代文本。一个重标注语料库本质上是由有据可查的标注策略（π）、描述器（V_c）和源语料库所诱导出的一个监督分布。基于长度相关性的代理指标会遗漏标注语域上的伪影，而下游的T2I基准测试又会将语料库本身与训练选择相互纠缠，因此这种监督分布难以在语料库规模上进行审计。我们提出了一个可复用的等预算审计框架，用于审计重标注监督分布 $D_{\pi,V_c,C}$：在固定文本预算 B = 64 的条件下，该框架报告一份涵盖提示词侧覆盖率、图像条件下的忠实度以及标注表面健康度的五轴画像，并以可控基本单元（CBU）作为统一的声称计量单位。我们在五个公开源语料库上通过七组成对比较对该框架进行了实例化验证。
tldr: 提出了一个在固定文本预算下对重标注图文语料所诱导的监督分布进行五轴画像审计的可复用框架，解决了该分布难以在语料库规模上进行系统性审计的问题。
en_tdlr: A reusable matched-budget audit framework that profiles recaptioned image-text supervision distributions across five axes at a fixed text budget, enabling systematic corpus-scale auditing of captioning policies, captioners, and source corpora.
